description.full_text: The image displays a camel-colored, mid-length wool coat with a notched collar and a matching belt tied at the waist. The coat is presented on a plain white background, giving it a clean and elegant look. The label inside reads "Max Mara." The overall mood is sophisticated and classic, emphasizing the coat's timeless design.
